text.card: A red giant 1,476 parsecs away, 17 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded by TESS, give 1.31 solar masses and 16.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,511 K at its surface.
